items.distractor_fact: Le thermomètre d'un voisin, relevé à la même heure, indiquait {D} °C.
items.gloss_en: A neighbor's thermometer, read at the same hour, showed {D} °C.
items.entity_note: a neighbor's own instrument (a person), not a different village's thermometer (a place) as in the first distractor, and not the thermometer whose morning and evening readings are compared

items.distractor_fact: Une obligation d'État se négociait à {D} € ce jour-là.
items.gloss_en: A government bond was trading at {D} € that day.
items.entity_note: a different financial instrument (a government bond), not a different listed company (an organisation) as in the first distractor, and not the stock whose close and open are compared

items.distractor_fact: Une échelle de crue installée sur un pont plus en aval indiquait un niveau de {D} cm ce même soir.
items.gloss_en: A flood gauge installed on a bridge further downstream showed a level of {D} cm that same evening.
items.entity_note: a fixed measuring instrument at another site, not a different river (a place) as in the first distractor, and not the river whose morning and evening levels are compared

items.distractor_fact: Une borne géodésique installée à l'entrée du parc indique une altitude de {D} m.
items.gloss_en: A geodesic marker installed at the park entrance shows an altitude of {D} m.
items.entity_note: a fixed instrument, not a different hiker (a person) as in the first distractor, and not either of the two landmarks whose altitudes are compared

items.distractor_fact: Un autre client de la banque a déposé un montant de {D} € ce même mois.
items.gloss_en: Another bank customer deposited an amount of {D} € that same month.
items.entity_note: a person (a different customer), not a different account as in the first distractor, and not the account whose deposit and withdrawal are compared

items.distractor_fact: Une personne vivant seule déclare avoir dépensé {D} € ce même mois.
items.gloss_en: A person living alone reports having spent {D} € that same month.
items.entity_note: a person (an individual), not a different household group as in the first distractor, and not the household whose income and expenses are compared

items.distractor_fact: Un attaquant vedette de la ligue a inscrit {D} buts à titre individuel cette saison.
items.gloss_en: A star forward in the league scored {D} goals individually this season.
items.entity_note: a person (an individual player), not a different team (an organisation) as in the first distractor, and not the team whose goals scored and conceded are compared

items.distractor_fact: L'année précédente, l'ensemble du secteur avait produit {D} t, un chiffre sans rapport avec l'objectif fixé cette année à l'usine étudiée ici.
items.gloss_en: The previous year, the sector as a whole had produced {D} t, a figure unrelated to the target set this year for the factory in question here.
items.entity_note: a different time series for a different aggregate entity (the whole sector, a year earlier), not a different factory (an organisation) as in the first distractor; explicitly unrelated to the stated target

items.distractor_fact: Sur le marché voisin, un vendeur indépendant, pour lequel aucun objectif n'a été fixé, a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de {D} € ce mois-ci.
items.gloss_en: At the neighboring market, an independent vendor, for whom no target has been set, made revenue of {D} € this month.
items.entity_note: a person (an independent vendor), not a different shop (an organisation) as in the first distractor; explicitly has no target set, unlike the objective given for the shop being compared

items.distractor_fact: Un agriculteur d'une exploitation voisine a mesuré, avec son propre pluviomètre, {D} mm ce mois-ci, un relevé sans lien avec les prévisions officielles étudiées ici.
items.gloss_en: A farmer at a neighboring farm measured, with his own rain gauge, {D} mm this month, a reading unrelated to the official forecast under study here.
items.entity_note: a person (a farmer with a private rain gauge), not a different region (a place) as in the first distractor; explicitly unrelated to the stated forecast

items.distractor_fact: Lors d'un tournoi disputé l'année précédente, {D} coups ont suffi pour boucler un parcours dont le par n'est pas précisé ici.
items.gloss_en: In a tournament played the previous year, {D} strokes were enough to complete a round on a course whose par is not given here.
items.entity_note: a different occasion (an earlier tournament, a series), not a different golf course (a place) as in the first distractor; its par is explicitly not stated, unlike the par compared in the story

items.distractor_fact: Le service de fret, exploité par une compagnie différente, a enregistré une arrivée à {D} min après son propre repère de référence, sans lien avec l'horaire voyageurs étudié ici.
items.gloss_en: The freight service, operated by a different company, recorded an arrival at {D} min after its own reference point, unrelated to the passenger schedule under study here.
items.entity_note: an organisation (a different operating company), not a different train (an instrument) as in the first distractor; explicitly unrelated to the stated passenger schedule

items.distractor_fact: Dans un centre commercial dont la maintenance est assurée par une société différente, un monte-charge s'est arrêté à un niveau numéroté {D} par rapport à son propre rez-de-chaussée.
items.gloss_en: In a shopping center maintained by a different company, a freight lift stopped at a level numbered {D} relative to its own ground floor.
items.entity_note: an organisation (a different maintenance company), not a different building (a place) as in the first distractor; referenced to its own ground floor, distinct from the elevator being compared

items.distractor_fact: Un hydrogéologue indépendant, chargé d'une étude distincte, a mesuré un niveau de {D} m par rapport à son propre repère de référence.
items.gloss_en: An independent hydrogeologist, in charge of a separate study, measured a level of {D} m relative to his own reference mark.
items.entity_note: a person (an independent hydrogeologist), not a different sensor (an instrument) as in the first distractor; referenced to his own mark, distinct from the sensor being compared

items.distractor_fact: Un autre projet immobilier, porté par un promoteur différent, prévoit une tour culminant à {D} m.
items.gloss_en: A different real-estate project, backed by a different developer, plans a tower reaching {D} m.
items.entity_note: an organisation (a different developer), not a different neighborhood (a place) as in the first distractor, and not the East or West tower being compared
